firstDraftValidity.note: All 32 drafts, graded by the current validator. Before scientific notation (1e-9) was added to the lexer, 20 of the same 32 drafts parsed as valid.

heldOutDrafts.request: Signal when price breaks above the highest high of the last 50 bars
heldOutDrafts.code:
breakoutLen = input(50, "Breakout Length", 2, 200, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

prevHH = highest(high, breakoutLen)[1]
buySig = bar_index > breakoutLen and close > prevHH

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Breakout", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Breakout", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

plot(close, "Price", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(prevHH, "50-Bar High", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(close, "Price", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d")
plot3d(prevHH, "Breakout Level", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Breakout of the previous 10-bar range with volume confirmation
heldOutDrafts.code:
rangeLen = input(10, "Range Length", 5, 50, 1)
volLen = input(20, "Volume Avg Length", 5, 100, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volume Multiplier", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

prevHighRaw = highest(high, rangeLen)
prevLowRaw = lowest(low, rangeLen)
prevHigh = prevHighRaw[1]
prevLow = prevLowRaw[1]
volAvg = sma(volume, volLen)
volOk = volume > volAvg * volMult
breakUp = close > prevHigh
breakDn = close < prevLow
buySig = breakUp and volOk
sellSig = breakDn and volOk

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

plot(prevHigh, "Prev High", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(prevLow, "Prev Low", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(prevHigh, "Prev High 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(prevLow, "Prev Low 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: RSI smoothed with a 3-bar SMA, signal when it crosses 50
heldOutDrafts.code:
rsiLen = input(14, "RSI Length", 2, 50, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

rawRsi = rsi(close, rsiLen)
smoothRsi = sma(rawRsi, 3)

buySig = smoothRsi > 50 and smoothRsi[1] <= 50
sellSig = smoothRsi < 50 and smoothRsi[1] >= 50

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(smoothRsi, "Smooth RSI", "#2962ff", 2, "line", "separate")
plot(rawRsi, "Raw RSI", "#888888", 1, "line", "separate")
hline(50, "#787b86", "separate")
plot3d(smoothRsi, "Smooth RSI 3D", "ribbon", "#2962ff", "separate")
plot3d(rawRsi, "Raw RSI 3D", "trail", "#888888", "separate", 1)

input(20, "BB Length", 2, 100, 1)
input(2.0, "BB Mult", 0.5, 4.0, 0.1)
input(120, "Squeeze Lookback", 20, 250, 1)
input(10, "Breakout Window", 2, 30, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

basis = sma(close, 20)
sd = stdev(close, 20)
upper = basis + 2.0 * sd
lower = basis - 2.0 * sd
bandwidth = (upper - lower) / (basis + 1e-9)
sqLowLong = lowest(bandwidth, 120)
lowShort = lowest(bandwidth, 10)
wasSqueeze = lowShort == sqLowLong
inSqueeze = bandwidth == sqLowLong

var lastLabel = -1000

buySig = crossover(close, upper) and wasSqueeze
sellSig = crossunder(close, lower) and wasSqueeze

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 1, "3d")
}
if buySig and bar_index - lastLabel > 20 {
    label3d(bar_index, high, "Squeeze Break", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "3d")
    lastLabel := bar_index
}
if sellSig and bar_index - lastLabel > 20 {
    label3d(bar_index, low, "Squeeze Break", "#ff4477", 1.0, 1, "3d")
    lastLabel := bar_index
}

plot(basis, "Basis", "#ffcc33", 1, "line")
plot(upper, "Upper", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(lower, "Lower", "#ff4477", 1, "line")
plot3d(upper, "BB Upper 3D", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lower, "BB Lower 3D", "ribbon", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Turtle trading entry: 20-bar high breakout, exit on a 10-bar low

heldOutDrafts.code:
input(14, "W%R Length", 2, 100, 1)
input(3, "Smooth Length", 1, 20, 1)
input(-80, "Oversold Level", -100, -50, 1)
input(-20, "Overbought Level", -50, 0, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

hh = highest(high, 14)
ll = lowest(low, 14)
rng = hh - ll
wrRaw = rng == 0 ? 0 : (hh - close) / rng * -100
wr = wrRaw
wrSmooth = sma(wr, 3)

buySig = crossover(wr, -80)
sellSig = crossunder(wr, -20)

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, wr, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, wr, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 1, "separate")
}

plot(wr, "Williams %R", "#7b5cff", 2, "line")
plot(wrSmooth, "W%R Smooth", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
hline(-80, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(-20, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(-50, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(wr, "W%R Ribbon", "ribbon", "#7b5cff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(wrSmooth, "W%R Smooth Layer", "line3d", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Volume spike detector: volume above twice its 20-bar average
heldOutDrafts.code:
len = input(20, "Avg Length", 2, 100, 1)
mult = input(2.0, "Spike Multiple", 1.0, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

volAvg = sma(volume, len)
spikeLevel = volAvg * mult
spike = volume > spikeLevel

if spike {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Spike", "triangleup", "#ffcc00")
}

if spike {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, volume, "Spike", "cube", "#ffcc00", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(volume, "Volume", "#3aa0ff", 1, "columns")
plot(spikeLevel, "2x Avg", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(volume, "Volume 3D", "bars3d", "#3aa0ff", "separate")
plot3d(spikeLevel, "Threshold 3D", "line3d", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Swing high and swing low markers using pivots
heldOutDrafts.code:
leftLen = input(5, "Left Bars", 1, 20, 1)
rightLen = input(5, "Right Bars", 1, 20, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ph = pivothigh(high, leftLen, rightLen)
pl = pivotlow(low, leftLen, rightLen)

swingHigh = ph > 0
swingLow = pl > 0

phBar = bar_index - rightLen

if swingHigh {
  plotshape(phBar, ph, "Swing High", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(phBar, ph, "Swing High", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

if swingLow {
  plotshape(phBar, pl, "Swing Low", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(phBar, pl, "Swing Low", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

plot(ph, "Swing High", "#ff4477", 2, "circles")
plot(pl, "Swing Low", "#22cc88", 2, "circles")
plot3d(high, "Swing Highs", "ribbon", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(low, "Swing Lows", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: VWAP with standard deviation bands and signals on band touches
heldOutDrafts.code:
input(true, "Reset Daily", 0, 1, 1)
input(1.0, "Band Mult 1", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
input(2.0, "Band Mult 2", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tp = (high + low + close) / 3
v = volume
dRef = security("1d", close)
newDay = bar_index == 0 or dRef != dRef[1]

var cumPV = 0.0
var cumV = 0.0
var cumP2V = 0.0

if newDay {
  cumPV := tp * v
  cumV := v
  cumP2V := tp * tp * v
} else {
  cumPV := cumPV[1] + tp * v
  cumV := cumV[1] + v
  cumP2V := cumP2V[1] + tp * tp * v
}

vwap = cumV > 0 ? cumPV / cumV : tp
meanSq = cumV > 0 ? cumP2V / cumV : tp * tp
vari = meanSq - vwap * vwap
variFix = vari > 0 ? vari : 0
sd = sqrt(variFix)

upper1 = vwap + input1 * sd
lower1 = vwap - input1 * sd
upper2 = vwap + input2 * sd
lower2 = vwap - input2 * sd

buySig = low <= lower2
sellSig = high >= upper2

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * input3, 0, "3d")
}

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * input3, 0, "3d")
}

plot(vwap, "VWAP", "#22aaff", 2, "line")
plot(upper1, "Upper 1SD", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower1, "Lower 1SD", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot(upper2, "Upper 2SD", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower2, "Lower 2SD", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
fill(upper2, lower2, "#22aaff")

plot3d(vwap, "VWAP 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "3d")
plot3d(upper2, "Upper 2SD 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lower2, "Lower 2SD 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 2)

heldOutDrafts.request: CCI smoothed over 3 bars with zero-line cross signals
heldOutDrafts.code:
cciLen = input(20, "CCI Length", 2, 100, 1)
smoothLen = input(3, "Smooth Length", 1, 10, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tp = (high + low + close) / 3
tpSma = sma(tp, cciLen)
dev = abs(tp - tpSma)
meanDev = sma(dev, cciLen)
cciRaw = (tp - tpSma) / (0.015 * (meanDev + 1e-9))
cciSmooth = sma(cciRaw, smoothLen)

buySig = cciSmooth > 0 and cciSmooth[1] <= 0
sellSig = cciSmooth < 0 and cciSmooth[1] >= 0

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, cciSmooth, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, cciSmooth, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(cciSmooth, "CCI Smooth", "#22cc88", 2, "line")
plot(cciRaw, "CCI Raw", "#888888", 1, "line")
hline(0, "#888888")
plot3d(cciSmooth, "CCI Smooth 3D", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(cciRaw, "CCI Raw 3D", "trail", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Midline of the 20-bar high/low channel with crossover signals
heldOutDrafts.code:
len = input(20, "Channel Length", 2, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

chHigh = highest(high, len)
chLow = lowest(low, len)
mid = (chHigh + chLow) / 2

buySig = crossover(close, mid)
sellSig = crossunder(close, mid)

}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 2, "3d")
}

plot(chHigh, "Channel High", "#ff4477", 1, "line")
plot(chLow, "Channel Low", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(mid, "Midline", "#ffcc33", 2, "line")
plot3d(chHigh, "High 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 0)
plot3d(chLow, "Low 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)
plot3d(mid, "Midline 3D", "line3d", "#ffcc33", "3d", 2)

heldOutDrafts.request: Rolling z-score of close over 30 bars with signals at plus and minus 2
heldOutDrafts.code:
len = input(30, "Z Length", 2, 200, 1)
upperThresh = input(2.0, "Upper Signal", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
lowerThresh = input(-2.0, "Lower Signal", -5.0, -0.5, 0.1)
smoothLen = input(5, "Smooth Length", 1, 30, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

mean = sma(close, len)
sd = stdev(close, len)
safeSd = sd < 1e-9
zScore = safeSd ? 0.0 : (close - mean) / sd
zSmooth = ema(zScore, smoothLen)

buySig = zScore[1] >= lowerThresh and zScore < lowerThresh
sellSig = zScore[1] <= upperThresh and zScore > upperThresh

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, zScore, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, zScore, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(zScore, "Z-Score", "#33aaff", 1, "line", "separate")
plot(zSmooth, "Z-Smooth", "#ffaa22", 1, "line", "separate")
hline(upperThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
hline(lowerThresh, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(0.0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(zScore, "Z-Score 3D", "ribbon", "#33aaff", "separate")
plot3d(zSmooth, "Z-Smooth 3D", "line3d", "#ffaa22", "separate", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Ichimoku-style conversion and base lines with crossover signals
heldOutDrafts.code:
input(9, "Conversion Length", 2, 50, 1)
input(26, "Base Length", 5, 100, 1)
input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

convHigh = highest(high, 9)
convLow = lowest(low, 9)
baseHigh = highest(high, 26)
baseLow = lowest(low, 26)
convLine = (convHigh + convLow) / 2
baseLine = (baseHigh + baseLow) / 2
spread = convLine - baseLine

buySig = crossover(convLine, baseLine)
sellSig = crossunder(convLine, baseLine)

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0, 0, "3d")
}

plot(convLine, "Conversion", "#22cc88", 2, "line")
plot(baseLine, "Base", "#ff4477", 2, "line")
fill(convLine, baseLine, "#22cc8844")
plot3d(convLine, "Conv Ribbon", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d")
plot3d(baseLine, "Base Line", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

heldOutDrafts.request: Fibonacci retracement levels of the last 50-bar swing with touch signals
heldOutDrafts.code:
swingLen = input(50, "Swing Length", 2, 200, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, swingLen)
swingLow = lowest(low, swingLen)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow
lev0 = swingLow
lev236 = swingLow + 0.236 * rng
lev382 = swingLow + 0.382 * rng
lev50 = swingLow + 0.5 * rng
lev618 = swingLow + 0.618 * rng
lev786 = swingLow + 0.786 * rng
lev100 = swingHigh
isBull = close > open
isBear = close < open
touch0 = low <= lev0 and high >= lev0
touch236 = low <= lev236 and high >= lev236
touch382 = low <= lev382 and high >= lev382
touch50 = low <= lev50 and high >= lev50
touch618 = low <= lev618 and high >= lev618
touch786 = low <= lev786 and high >= lev786
touch100 = low <= lev100 and high >= lev100
supportTouch = touch0 or touch236 or touch382
resistTouch = touch618 or touch786 or touch100
buySig = supportTouch and isBull or touch50 and isBull
sellSig = resistTouch and isBear or touch50 and isBear

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

plot(lev0, "0%", "#888888", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev236, "23.6%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev382, "38.2%", "#33aaff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev50, "50%", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev618, "61.8%", "#ff8833", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev786, "78.6%", "#cc44ff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev100, "100%", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(lev0, "0%", "line3d", "#888888", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lev236, "23.6%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lev382, "38.2%", "line3d", "#33aaff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(lev50, "50%", "line3d", "#ffcc33", "3d", 3)
plot3d(lev618, "61.8%", "line3d", "#ff8833", "3d", 4)
plot3d(lev786, "78.6%", "line3d", "#cc44ff", "3d", 5)
plot3d(lev100, "100%", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 6)

heldOutDrafts.request: Breakdown below the lowest low of the last 30 bars with an exit marker
heldOutDrafts.code:
lookback = input(30, "Lookback", 1, 200, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

breakLevel = lowest(low, lookback)
prevLevel = breakLevel[1]
smoothLevel = sma(breakLevel, 5)

breakSig = close < prevLevel and bar_index > lookback
reclaimSig = close > prevLevel and bar_index > lookback

var inTrade = 0.0
var entryLvl = 0.0

isBreak = breakSig and inTrade == 0
isExit = inTrade == 1 and reclaimSig

if isBreak {
  inTrade := 1
  entryLvl := prevLevel
}

if isExit {
  inTrade := 0
  entryLvl := 0.0
}

if isBreak {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Breakdown", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

if isExit {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

plot(breakLevel, "Lowest Low 30", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(close, "Close", "#22aaff", 1, "line")
plot3d(close, "Price Ribbon", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "3d")
plot3d(breakLevel, "Breakdown Level", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)
plot3d(smoothLevel, "Level Trend", "line3d", "#ffbb33", "3d", 2)
plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Breakdown", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "3d")
plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Exit", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "3d")

heldOutDrafts.request: Momentum burst: close breaks the 15-bar high while RSI is above 60
heldOutDrafts.code:
len = input(15, "Lookback Length", 1, 100, 1)
rsiLen = input(14, "RSI Length", 2, 100, 1)
rsiThresh = input(60, "RSI Threshold", 50, 90, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = rsi(close, rsiLen)
hh = highest(high, len)
prevHigh = hh[1]
buySig = close > prevHigh and r > rsiThresh and bar_index > len

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Burst", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Burst", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

plot(close, "Price", "#22cc88", 1, "line")
plot(prevHigh, "15-Bar High", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(close, "Price", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "3d")
plot3d(prevHigh, "15-Bar High", "line3d", "#ffaa00", "3d", 1)
